text: Starting… Connecting… Saved Saving… Offline Not saved Restart tour Claude, or another AI app, can open, change and run your projects with you, through BBRouter’s MCP server. Connect it once: it asks you to sign in, then works as you, on your projects only. Then type /mcp in Claude Code, pick bbrouter and choose Authenticate to sign in. Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector: name it BBRouter, paste the address and click Add, then Connect and sign in. Any app that takes a remote MCP server (HTTP, with OAuth sign-in): give it the address. Step by step in the guide Connected apps Create a layout, or open one saved on the server. 1× 1/10 1/100 1/1000 ⏭ Nothing to control yet: variable jumpers, hole groups, warnings and the simulation show here. Click anything to pin a note to it. Fixed: part of the circuit; carries the net from one end to the other. Variable: moved by hand (a probe, a control line); breaks the net, so each end stays its own. Link copied Its owner stopped sharing the project, or the link isn’t whole. Ask them for a new one.
